title: App updates
ios_install_hint: TDrive checks for new versions automatically. For this sideloaded iOS app, download the new IPA and install it with the same sideloading tool. iOS does not allow the app to replace itself.
android_install_hint: TDrive checks for new versions automatically. Download the latest APK and open it to update. Android asks you to confirm installation.
